prompt:
Please determine whether the pelvic MRI report is related to prostate cancer (diagnosis, workup, or monitoring). Write "1" if the report is related to prostate cancer, "0" if unrelated to prostate cancer, and "N/A" if the reason or indication for the exam is unclear. Use the following rules:
- "1" (related to prostate cancer): Examples include exams done for a rising or elevated PSA, patients with prostatitis for whom prostate cancer is being ruled out, patients on active surveillance, and patients with suspected prostate cancer recurrence. This does NOT include exams done for other non-prostate malignancies, following up on indeterminate bone findings, benign or traumatic findings, infection, etc.
- "0" (unrelated to prostate cancer): Examples include MR urograms, MRIs done to evaluate bladder cancer or other non-prostate cancers, exams for sacroileitis, traumatic fractures, etc.
- "N/A" (unable to determine): This includes any report where the exam indication or reason is truly unclear based on the provided information.
{input}
